name: Colosseum to Trevi Fountain and the Pantheon
blurb: Ancient arches give way to baroque splendour as the walk climbs to the Trevi Fountain and ends at the domed Pantheon.

name: La Rambla to the Gothic Quarter and Port Vell
blurb: Plane-tree-lined La Rambla leads into the medieval lanes of the Gothic Quarter and down to the harbour under Columbus's column.

name: Central Station to Dam Square
blurb: Cyclists and trams stream past the old canal houses as the walk runs from Centraal Station down Damrak to the royal Dam Square.

name: Strada Nova to Rialto and St Mark's Square
blurb: From the railway station along the busy Strada Nova to the Rialto Bridge and on through the lanes to the golden basilica of St Mark's.

name: Old Town Square to Charles Bridge
blurb: Gothic spires frame the Old Town Square before the walk crosses the statue-lined Charles Bridge into the quiet streets of Malá Strana.

name: Ringstrasse to Stephansplatz
blurb: Imperial facades of the Ringstrasse, with the State Opera at its heart, lead to the Gothic spire of St Stephen's Cathedral.

name: Unter den Linden to the Brandenburg Gate
blurb: The lime-lined boulevard Unter den Linden runs past Bebelplatz to the Brandenburg Gate, the city's most famous monument.

name: Rossio to Alfama and Santa Luzia
blurb: Wave-patterned squares of the Baixa climb past the cathedral into the tiled, steep lanes of Alfama and its sunset lookout.

name: Gran Via to Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor
blurb: Belle Epoque facades line Gran Via as the walk runs through the bustling Puerta del Sol and on to the arcaded Plaza Mayor.

name: Danube Promenade from Parliament to Arpad Bridge
blurb: The Pest riverside promenade runs north from the neo-Gothic Parliament past Margaret Bridge, with Buda's hills in view across the Danube.

name: The Royal Mile
blurb: The cobbled spine of the Old Town runs from the castle on its volcanic rock down to the palace at Holyrood.

name: Grafton Street to Temple Bar
blurb: Shoppers and buskers fill Grafton Street, then the walk passes Trinity College and crosses the Ha'penny Bridge into lively Temple Bar.

name: Strøget to Nyhavn
blurb: The pedestrian Strøget shopping street runs from the City Hall Square to the colourful waterfront houses of Nyhavn.

name: Syntagma to Plaka and the Acropolis
blurb: From Syntagma Square through the bazaar of Monastiraki and the whitewashed lanes of Plaka, the walk climbs toward the Parthenon.

name: Plaza de Espana to the Cathedral and Las Setas
blurb: Tiled arches of the Plaza de Espana lead past the Alcazar gardens to the Gothic cathedral and the wooden mushrooms of Las Setas.
